elements.literalObservation: A black circular brand mark and lowercase wordmark sit at leading; search, calendar, circled-check, and ellipsis icons sit at trailing.
elements.rebuildDirective: Use a 60–64 point safe-area-aware row with a 20–22 point leading brand anchor and minimum 44-point semantic targets for each trailing action.
elements.platformMapping: SwiftUI toolbar or custom safe-area header

elements.literalObservation: A solid black circular mark has a white cutout at the upper-trailing edge.
elements.rebuildDirective: Render as a one-color vector, combine semantically with the wordmark, and hide the decorative shape from the accessibility tree.

elements.literalObservation: A magnifying-glass icon appears in the top toolbar.
elements.rebuildDirective: Use a semantic search toolbar button with a 44-by-44-point target and an explicit accessibility label.

elements.literalObservation: A calendar-grid icon appears in the top toolbar.
elements.rebuildDirective: Confirm its behavior, then expose it as a labeled date-jump or date-picker action; do not duplicate the Calendar tab without a distinct purpose.

elements.literalObservation: A circled checkmark appears only on Photos references.
elements.rebuildDirective: Confirm semantics; if it enters selection mode, expose selected state, count, cancel, and multi-select accessibility behavior.

elements.literalObservation: A horizontal ellipsis appears at the top-trailing edge.
elements.rebuildDirective: Use a semantic Menu for low-frequency actions and keep primary commands visible outside the menu.

elements.literalObservation: PHOTOS, CALENDAR, MAP, and RECIPES appear in one uppercase line separated by dots; PHOTOS is black and heavier, others gray.
elements.rebuildDirective: Implement as semantic tabs with 44-point targets and a non-color selected indicator; move meal count or allow controlled horizontal overflow before labels shrink.
elements.platformMapping: custom tab strip backed by TabView or enum state

elements.literalObservation: The label 277 MEALS sits at the trailing end of the destination line.
elements.rebuildDirective: Treat as metadata, not navigation; move it out of the crowded tab line at constrained widths.

elements.literalObservation: A sparkle icon, title, italic subtitle, REVIEW button, and close glyph form an inline banner.
elements.rebuildDirective: Keep the prompt dismissible and persistent by state; support multiline text and avoid occupying the entire first viewport after dismissal or completion.

elements.literalObservation: A thin rectangular button labeled REVIEW sits inside the catch-up banner.
elements.rebuildDirective: Use native Button semantics, a 44-point target, and loading/disabled feedback tied to candidate availability.

elements.literalObservation: A date heading and weekday sit above one or more rows of meal photos.
elements.rebuildDirective: Use semantic section headings and preserve source order; if headers stick, ensure contrast over scrolling photos.

elements.literalObservation: Six equal square photos form a three-column grid with tiny gutters.
elements.rebuildDirective: Use equal square tracks and 1–2 point gutters; preserve left-filled incomplete rows and do not convert to masonry.

elements.literalObservation: Each collection item is a full-color meal photograph cropped to a square.
elements.rebuildDirective: Use aspect-fill cached thumbnails, native metadata overlays, stable meal IDs, and one combined accessible action per tile.

elements.literalObservation: A small white time label appears over a translucent dark patch in the photo upper-leading corner.
elements.rebuildDirective: Use native text with an adaptive local scrim and include the time in the meal tile accessibility label.

elements.literalObservation: A large white sponsored block with SPONSORED and AD labels appears between date sections; creative is blurred.
elements.rebuildDirective: Keep ad disclosure explicit, avoid styling it as a personal meal, and reserve only the height required by the actual ad format.

elements.literalObservation: A persistent white bottom region contains equal CAMERA and LIBRARY actions framed by detached corner strokes.
elements.rebuildDirective: Keep Camera and Library as actions with rectangular 44-point-plus targets; reduce excess height while preserving the corner-bracket motif.

elements.literalObservation: CAMERA is centered inside four detached L-shaped corner strokes.
elements.rebuildDirective: Use native Button semantics and make the entire half-width cell tappable; brackets are decorative.

elements.literalObservation: LIBRARY is centered inside four detached L-shaped corner strokes.
elements.rebuildDirective: Use native photo picker presentation, preserve the full half-width target, and handle limited-library access.

elements.literalObservation: MAY 2026 is centered between small previous and next triangular controls.
elements.rebuildDirective: Use locale-aware month formatting and 44-point previous/next targets; announce the new month after change.

elements.literalObservation: A seven-column six-week month matrix uses white or photo-backed cells.
elements.rebuildDirective: Generate dates from Calendar and DateComponents, maintain 44-point day targets, and provide explicit selected/today/adjacent-month states.

elements.literalObservation: Each day cell contains a day number; occupied days use a meal photo background and may show a small trailing count.
elements.rebuildDirective: Use adaptive corner scrims for date/count contrast and expose full date plus meal count semantically.

elements.literalObservation: An Apple map fills the active panel between the destination strip and bottom action bar.
elements.rebuildDirective: Use an interactive MapKit map, preserve attribution, and prefer muted emphasis so custom meal annotations remain primary.

elements.literalObservation: Several geographic points are represented by overlapping square food-photo frames with white borders and shadows.
elements.rebuildDirective: At low zoom show a representative photo plus numeric count; limit visible stack depth, define selected state, and expand progressively with zoom.

elements.literalObservation: A bordered white label reads 228 MEALS ON THE MAP near the top center.
elements.rebuildDirective: Clarify whether the count is total or viewport-specific and avoid obscuring map controls or labels.

elements.literalObservation: A white surface with large rounded top corners sits over a dimmed parent screen.
elements.rebuildDirective: Use a system sheet with a content-fitting detent when possible, one clear dismiss control, and progress/cancel states.

elements.literalObservation: Four bordered rows offer mutually exclusive look-back ranges; LAST 30 DAYS has a trailing black dot.
elements.rebuildDirective: Make each full row selectable and expose visible selected and unselected control states with radio/check semantics.

elements.literalObservation: START SCAN is centered inside a wide corner-bracket frame.
elements.rebuildDirective: Use a prominent semantic button, prevent duplicate starts, and replace the label with progress/cancel feedback during scanning.

elements.literalObservation: A gray serif italic line states that the classifier is on-device with no internet or upload.
elements.rebuildDirective: Raise contrast, define the serif accent token explicitly, and keep the claim synchronized with actual implementation.

elements.literalObservation: A large rounded white sheet over a gray backdrop contains Settings.
elements.rebuildDirective: Use a large sheet with NavigationStack and grouped List; preserve the single-sheet return path.

elements.literalObservation: TOOLS, HELP, LEGAL, and ABOUT divide full-width settings rows.
elements.rebuildDirective: Use semantic list sections, sufficient contrast, and dynamic row heights for localization and Dynamic Type.

elements.literalObservation: A tracked uppercase label and a pale trailing chevron form each navigational settings row.
elements.rebuildDirective: Use NavigationLink semantics, a minimum 52–56-point row, stronger chevron contrast, and multiline support.

elements.literalObservation: The final About row combines brand mark, wordmark, and italic food memory · v1.2 (23) subtitle.
elements.rebuildDirective: Keep product/version information grouped, hide decorative layers from accessibility, and deemphasize build number unless needed for support.

reconstruction.directive: Rebuild grumbl. as a monochrome photographic contact-sheet archive with a branded top toolbar, semantic text tabs, date-grouped three-column meal grids, a thumbnail calendar, photo-stack map annotations, persistent Camera/Library actions, and large utility sheets, while correcting contrast, selected-state, localization, and Dynamic Type constraints.
layoutRules: Calibrate the 1284 by 2778 references to an approximately 428 by 926 point compact portrait frame at 3x.
Use a 60–64 point branded masthead and a 36–40 point semantic destination strip.
Keep Photos in three equal square columns with 1–2 point gutters and left-filled incomplete rows.
Keep Camera and Library in a persistent bottom action region rather than navigation.
Generate a locale-aware seven-column month calendar with at least 44-point day targets.
Use MapKit clustering with count-bearing representative photo annotations at low zoom.
Use content-fitting Scan sheet detents and a large Settings sheet.
Move meal count out of the tab line when width or text size is constrained.
Preserve black, white, gray, hairlines, natural photos, and the corner-bracket motif.

prohibitions: Do not call Camera and Library navigation tabs.
Do not replace the three-column contact sheet with masonry.
Do not add colored app chrome, glass panels, or card dashboards.
Do not rely only on gray-versus-black weight for selected tabs.
Do not force localized or large text into the current single-line tracked widths.
Do not show photo map piles without count, selection, and zoom behavior.
Do not reproduce blurred advertising creative.
Do not add calorie, macro, streak, or social-feed modules to this visual reconstruction.

qa.target: six screenshots represented in exact App Store order
three equal square columns with 1–2 point gutters
selected destination remains clear without relying only on color
qa.tolerance: one semantic selected tab at all times

qa.target: Camera and Library are two equal buttons, not tabs
day and count remain readable over every thumbnail fixture
low-zoom clusters show representative image, count, and selected state
no truncation or overlap in tabs, scan, settings, or bottom actions
